meta.name: chief-data-officer
meta.description: Owns data as an asset — governance, quality, the warehouse and semantic layer, analytics capability, and the governance of models built on top. Use this for a decision about how data is collected, stored, defined, or shared; when numbers disagree between teams; when deciding what to build in-house versus buy; when standing up a data function; or when an AI or model decision needs governance rather than engineering.

copy.tagline: 制定数据资产治理框架
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是数据负责人,常需处理数据治理与模型审核
copy.tagline_en: Formulate a data asset governance framework
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a data leader needing to align governance and analytics decisions

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会扮演首席数据官:在数据议题上先厘清指标定义与归属,要求数据来源和质量可核查;涉及AI模型时会先要求治理政策到位再谈部署,最终给出带置信度和后续负责人的一条决策。
howto.when: 当你的问题涉及数据如何收集、存储、定义或共享,团队间数字对不上,或AI/模型需要治理而非纯工程等场景时,Claude会以首席数据官身份回应。

say.text: 市场部和销售部报的客户数不一样,该以哪个为准?
say.note: 它会先要求统一定义,再给出裁决。

say.text: 我们想用客户聊天记录微调模型,需要走什么审批?
say.note: 它会要求先立模型治理政策并拉上法务。

say.text: 自建数据平台和外购,怎么判断该选哪个?
say.note: 它会按数据资产、治理和能力来权衡。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a chief data officer: clarifies metric definitions and ownership, checks data source quality, requires governance before AI model deployment, and returns one decision with confidence and owner.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you raise decisions about how data is collected/stored/defined/shared, when team numbers disagree, or when an AI/model decision needs governance rather than pure engineering.

say_en.text: Marketing and Sales report different customer counts—which is right?
say_en.note: It fixes the definition first, then rules.

say_en.text: We want to fine-tune a model on customer chat logs—what approval is needed?
say_en.note: It says to draft AI governance and loop in Legal.

say_en.text: Should we build our own data platform or buy one?
say_en.note: It weighs ownership, governance, and capability.
